question: Does scheduled CALIT 1511 identify the lower fixed-tier auditorium in the public QI event diagram, rather than the upper black-box theater?

confirmedFacts.fact: Floor 1 lists room 1511, Room key 31372, 2865 sqft. This source does not supply a usable room polygon or a venue name.
The Auditorium has fixed tiered seating and capacity 200; the distinct Theater supports different setups, capacity 90 (70 seated).
Calit2 Theater is a reconfigurable two-story black-box space with movable seating up to 90.
Separate Theater and Auditorium sections corroborate a 90-guest configurable theater and an auditorium of up to 201 seats.
The supplied diagram visibly distinguishes the lower stepped seating and stage enclosure from the upper open rectangle. No numeric room labels were visible in the diagram.

numberNameLink.retrievalStatus: Original PDF acquired and page 7 rendered and visually inspected. The direct Main Auditorium–Room 1511 statement is confirmed; page footer identifies November 2006.

numberNameLink.interpretation: Explicit historical room name-to-number statement in a directly inspected professional-association announcement. This remains a secondary historical source, not a modern UCSD as-built verification.

otherSourcesReviewed.result: 12-page institutional brochure text confirms separate Auditorium and Theater; no 1511 text match.
Official linked venue sheet rows 6/7 identify Auditorium 200 and Black Box Theater 90 without room numbers.
Official publication record confirms a 2006 NEES/UCSD seminar on this topic but does not name its room.
Official 2009 course event uses Atkinson Hall Main Auditorium; no 1511.

recommendation.geometry: The visible lower auditorium enclosure may be traced as a source-derived venue shape independently of assigning 1511.
recommendation.numberLink: Crosswalk now supported by a directly inspected original November 2006 announcement. Preserve the historical date and publisher, and do not describe it as a current floor-plan room label or present-day as-built verification.
recommendation.scale: The FIS 2865 sqft value can only be used as an explicitly declared area-based scale after identity is accepted; it does not independently prove the room identity.
recommendation.placement: No geographic or north orientation was established by this review.
